facts.fact: The Bamada.net report says that on 19 July 2024 the President launched digitalisation of public services in Mali, so that ID card fees, police fines and civil-status acts can be paid by mobile phone, first in Bamako, with extension to the regions and embassies and later to taxes and public procurement.
